decisions.quote: Thus, using the same approach used by Guo et al. (2022b) study, we have replicated the finding of the effect of Covid status on accuracy, but not on RTs.
decisions.location: Section 3.1.1 (Results, p. 211, lines 727-729); also Abstract (p. 205, lines 45-57) and Section 5 (Discussion, p. 220, lines 1785-1790)
decisions.reason: The replication explicitly tested Guo et al.'s (2022b) reported effects of Covid status on both accuracy and reaction times across two memory tasks, and the authors repeatedly frame their replication result as replicating the accuracy effect while failing to replicate the reaction time effect; the broad closing sentence in the abstract ('replicates and extends previously reported findings') summarizes the study's dual replication-and-extension scope rather than overriding this explicit contrast on a central tested finding.
